Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000709": The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.  (about: Yuki, monthly cost review)
- memory_id "1000683" [decision]: As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000667": On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000642": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000635" [preference]: As of 2025-08-29, for anything Cinder-related, page Diego.  (about: Team Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000613": The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000602" [constraint]: Changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000588": INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000565": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Team Cinder, billing service)
- memory_id "1000562": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000556" [decision]: On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Team Cinder, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000514": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000475": On 2025-06-23, Team Cinder observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Cinder, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000445": As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000341": Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000305" [decision]: As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000201": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000108": The indexer lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, indexer)
Existing entity names: Yuki, monthly cost review, ledger, event bus, reporting service, Team Boreal, notifier, Team Atlas, catalog service, Team Cinder, Diego, indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, billing service, feature-flags service, resizer, reports pipeline
